facts.heading: Tomas is nervous about therapy
facts.content: Tomas is quite nervous about attending therapy.
facts.evidence: I am quite nervous, if I am honest.

facts.heading: Wife suggested therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he seek therapy because the current situation cannot continue.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove about 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time taken to leave apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour before he can leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Checking routine details
facts.content: Tomas's checking routine involves locking the door, going to the elevator, returning to pull the bolt, and checking the stove knobs and timer before checking the door again.
facts.evidence: I lock the door, I go to the elevator, I come back and pull the bolt. Then I check the stove, every knob of the timer. Then the door again.

facts.heading: Anxiety and burning images
facts.content: When checking, Tomas feels anxious and sees an image of himself in flames, believing he might have done something improperly.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Burning images occur daily
facts.content: The images of being in flames happen every day for Tomas.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Worst time for images
facts.content: The images are worst in the evening when going out or to sleep, and also in the morning.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. And in the morning too.

facts.heading: Onset linked to house fire
facts.content: Tomas's issues started two years ago after a neighbor's house caught fire and they had to evacuate.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience of house fire
facts.content: Tomas witnessed the neighbor's house burn down completely while standing outside in the yard.
facts.evidence: I stood outside in the yard and watched the window burn.

facts.heading: Feeling of personal responsibility
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas feels he can cause it and will be responsible if he doesn't control something.
facts.evidence: At that time, I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be responsible.

facts.heading: Physical symptoms of anxiety
facts.content: When trying to stop the behavior, Tomas experiences a pounding heart and stomach discomfort.
facts.evidence: My heart pounded in my hand and my stomach felt bad.

facts.heading: Wife is aware of the issue
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbara, knows about the issue, and she now sees it is more than just a habit.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife. At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema 40 minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to lateness
facts.content: Barbara waited outside for Tomas, and the argument ended after the third look from her.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to come back and the argument ended after the third. She didn't say anything, just looked at me.

facts.heading: Feeling like a child
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who cannot leave the house.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Job role as electrician
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec. He does wiring in apartments and houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Concerns about making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas is afraid of making a mistake that could cause flooding or damage.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake, that I might fall into a flood or something get damaged.

facts.heading: Checks on ongoing jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to ongoing jobs the next day just to look and check.
facts.evidence: But I go back for checks on ongoing jobs. Just when I go back the next day, just to look.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss tells him he is the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Work slowing down
facts.content: In the last few months, Tomas's work has slowed down by an hour per day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day.

facts.heading: Fear of losing job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Probora, is pregnant in the fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waiting for child three years
facts.content: Tomas and his partner waited for the child for three years.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years

facts.heading: Intrusive thoughts about harm
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that it would harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it would harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thought about cutting bread
facts.content: Tomas experiences a thought while cutting bread on the landing that it might go by itself.
facts.evidence: But the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing and then I'm afraid that it will go by itself.

facts.heading: Thoughts are worst when private
facts.content: Tomas finds the thoughts are worst when he hasn't told anyone, not even Barbora.
facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone. Not even Barbora.

facts.heading: Coping with thoughts by leaving
facts.content: When a thought appears, Tomas leaves the room.
facts.evidence: I leave the room.

facts.heading: Coping with thoughts by checking
facts.content: Tomas sometimes checks something when a thought appears to make it stop.
facts.evidence: Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern involves checking
facts.content: Tomas sleeps intermittently and gets up twice at night to check sporadically.
facts.evidence: I get up twice at night and check sporadically, even if there is nothing there.

facts.heading: Walking helps keep busy
facts.content: Tomas and Barbora go for walks when there is something going on at home to keep him busy.
facts.evidence: We go for walks with Barbara when there is something going on at home. It keeps me busy.

facts.heading: Frequency of walks
facts.content: Tomas goes for walks about twice a week.
facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, just about.

facts.heading: Goal to leave woods
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to be able to leave the woods in five minutes.
facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.

facts.heading: Goal regarding child
facts.content: Tomas hopes to look forward to a child without having those thoughts.
facts.evidence: And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person gradually exposes themselves to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced
facts.content: Tomas feared someone would force him to leave the door open.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Tomas finds the suggestion to check the door once to be big for him.
facts.evidence: It sounds small, but it is big for me.

facts.heading: Feelings for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas loves Barbora and has not lost his interest in her.
facts.evidence: That I love her. And that I haven't lost my interest in her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas is afraid that Barbora wouldn't want to be with him.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Belief about Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas believes Barbora would hug him.
facts.evidence: She would hug me. That's how she is.

facts.heading: Decision on telling Barbora
facts.content: Tomas is not ready to talk about his thoughts with Barbora yet.
facts.evidence: It's like that. Not about those thoughts yet.

facts.heading: Plan to check door once
facts.content: Tomas will try checking the door just once when leaving the apartment.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Plan to write down number
facts.content: Tomas will write down a number from one to ten.
facts.evidence: And I'll write down a number from one to ten.
